summary: US CENTCOM completed strikes on IRGC targets across multiple Iranian provinces including Khuzestan, Sistan-Baluchestan, Hormozgan, and Kerman, with Iranian Foreign Ministry reporting martyrdoms and injuries among civilians in a US strike on a wedding in Kouhestak, Sirik district, Hormozgan province. Iran's armed forces conducted retaliatory strikes against US military bases in Kuwait and Bahrain, with launches detected toward Jordan and explosions reported in Eilat. Israel's Defense Minister warned the Islamic Republic may attack during the upcoming holiday period.

Iran's armed forces struck US military bases in Kuwait and Bahrain in retaliation for US strikes on Iranian territory (Source: @asafroz/53002)

Iran's Foreign Ministry confirmed retaliatory strikes were directed at US bases that were the source of attacks against Iranian territory, citing legitimate self-defense (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/388365)
Israeli Defense Minister warned the Islamic Republic may attack Israel during the upcoming holiday period (Source: @kianmeli1/91454)
Iranian border guards seized a vessel carrying 382,000 liters of smuggled fuel in the northern Gulf and detained 11 foreign suspects (Source: @naya_foriraq/89228)
Iran reported at least 3 Basij members killed in US attack on Lavan Island (Source: @rodast_omiddana/80206)

sections.executive_summary: US CENTCOM completed strikes on IRGC targets in Iran, prompting Iranian retaliatory strikes against US bases in Kuwait and Bahrain. Iran's Foreign Ministry condemned the US attacks as aggression, reporting civilian casualties including in a Kouhestak wedding strike in Hormozgan province, and confirmed retaliatory strikes against US bases. Israeli Defense Minister warned the Islamic Republic may attack during the upcoming holiday period, while Iranian launches toward Jordan were detected and Eilat residents reported explosions.

points: Iran's Foreign Ministry condemned US attacks on multiple Iranian provinces (Khuzestan, Sistan-Baluchestan, Hormozgan, and Kerman), reporting civilian casualties from strikes on communications infrastructure and a Kouhestak wedding in Sirik district, Hormozgan, where more than 70 were killed or wounded. The statement confirmed retaliatory strikes against US bases that served as launching points for the aggression against Iran. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/388365)

Iranian armed forces conducted retaliatory strikes against US military bases in Kuwait and Bahrain in response to US strikes on Iranian territory, citing legitimate self-defense rights. (Source: @asafroz/53002)
Reports indicate that at least 3 Basij members were killed in the US attack on Lavan Island. (Source: @rodast_omiddana/80206)
Iranian border guards seized a vessel carrying 382,000 liters of smuggled fuel in the northern Gulf and detained 11 foreign suspects. (Source: @naya_foriraq/89228)

Iran's ambassador to international organizations, Mohsen Naziri Ashtiani, stated that Iran's military response to US strikes was 'certain' and will not be limited. An Iranian military source affirmed Iran will respond 'with certainty.' (Source: @kianmeli1/91454, @inon_yttach/9998)

Iranian media claimed that three regime missiles were intercepted in Shahr-e Kord, Sirik, and Khomein, with claims about reduced missile effectiveness due to prior strikes on production facilities. (Source: @rodast_omiddana/80199)

The IAEA stated it does not know the exact status of the Isfahan enrichment facility and has not conducted field verification at any nuclear facility in Iran since February. The quarterly Board of Governors meeting will be held next week with Iran on the agenda. (Source: @naya_foriraq/89227, @SharghDaily/181479)
Israeli Defense Minister warned that the Islamic Republic may attack Israel during the upcoming holiday period. (Source: @kianmeli1/91454)

Sirens sounded in multiple northern border communities due to a 'suspicious aerial target' that likely crossed from Lebanon into Israeli territory; interceptor missiles were launched at the suspected drone. (Source: @manniefabian/59082)
Red alert sirens activated at 04:26 in Dafna and HaGushurim (Golan Heights frontier area), with Tsofar sirens also sounding. (Source: @New_security8200/203564)

The IDF announced the elimination of Talal Mustafa Saleh Badawi, a commander in Hamas's Gaza City Brigade Military Security Department, and Momen Saeed Mohammed Al-Hawari, another Hamas operative, justifying the strike during a ceasefire due to systematic violations. (Source: @shin_persian/9394)

The Israeli Navy's sixth submarine, INS Drakon (Dragon), departed Kiel, Germany en route to Israel, with a ceremony to be held at Haifa Naval Base upon arrival. The Dolphin 2-class submarine features advanced technologies; the class will retain the 'Dakar' name for future submarines scheduled for delivery in the early 2030s. (Source: @manniefabian/59078)
Eilat residents reported hearing explosions, likely as a result of Iranian fire toward Jordan. (Source: @inon_yttach/10000)

Former IDF Chief of Staff Gadi Eisenkot recounted at a Yedioth conference that in February 2018, after an F-16 was shot down in Syria, he decided on a broad strike against Syrian and Iranian targets while Netanyahu was unavailable; Netanyahu arrived after three hours and halted further strikes. (Source: @yediotnews25/134581)

Two Hamas operatives, including commander Talal Mustafa Saleh Badawi of Hamas's Gaza City Brigade Military Security Department, and Momen Saeed Mohammed Al-Hawari were killed in an IDF strike in the Gaza Strip on Monday. The IDF justified the strike during a ceasefire by stating both had advanced attacks against troops and civilians and were attempting to restore Hamas capabilities. (Source: @manniefabian/59084)
Clashes were reported in Beita, south of Nablus, with several Arab-owned vehicles set on fire. (Source: @lelotsenzura/94290)
Hamas Political Bureau member Bassem Naeem made statements regarding Palestinian resistance. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/388364)

Sirens sounded in multiple Israeli northern border communities due to a 'suspicious aerial target' that likely crossed from Lebanon into Israeli territory; interceptor missiles were launched at the suspected drone. (Source: @manniefabian/59082)
Lebanese warplanes conducted low-altitude flights over the Western Bekaa. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/388358)
Footage and NASA FIRMS data confirm a strike on the US base at Erbil International Airport in Iraq. (Source: @shin_persian/9392)
US Treasury Secretary stated the US is conducting comprehensive discussions with all supporters of Iran, with a message to all parties to distance themselves from Iran. (Source: @naya_foriraq/89219)

German military officials confirmed Germany successfully tested an Israeli-made LORA ballistic missile with a range of up to 500 km in the North Atlantic overnight, according to Reuters. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/6766)
Iran struck US military targets in Kuwait and Bahrain overnight in retaliation for US strikes on Iranian territory. (Source: @asafroz/53002)
Launches from Iran were detected toward Jordan. (Source: @pkpoi/143804)
After Trump's threats, explosions were reported in Jordan according to local reports. (Source: @inon_yttach/9999)
Iranian border guards seized a vessel carrying 382,000 liters of smuggled fuel in the northern Gulf and detained 11 foreign suspects. (Source: @naya_foriraq/89228)

Iran's Foreign Ministry called on regional states to prevent the use of their territories and capabilities for US aggression against Iran and to prevent the expansion of war in the region. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/388365)
European gas prices rose to their highest levels in 3 years due to escalating Middle East tensions. (Source: @naya_foriraq/89215)
The aircraft carrier Abraham Lincoln docked at Laem Chabang Port in Thailand near Pattaya after over 200 consecutive days at sea, with 5,000 crew receiving five days of rest. (Source: @asafroz/53004)

sections.threat_assessment: The situation is highly escalatory, with confirmed US strikes on IRGC targets across at least four Iranian provinces and direct Iranian retaliatory strikes against US bases in Kuwait and Bahrain. Iranian ballistic missile launches toward Jordan were detected, with explosions reported in Eilat, indicating an expanding theater of conflict that risks drawing in additional regional actors. Israeli Defense Ministry warnings of potential Iranian attack during the holiday period, combined with suspicious aerial targets crossing from Lebanon into Israeli airspace, suggest a multi-front threat environment. The presence of the Abraham Lincoln carrier strike group in Thailand after over 200 days at sea and ongoing German-Israeli military cooperation, including the LORA missile test, indicates sustained Western military posture in support of Israel.
sections.regional_response: Iran's Foreign Ministry called on regional states to prevent the use of their territories for US aggression and to prevent the expansion of war, signaling diplomatic efforts to isolate US basing in the Gulf. European gas prices reached three-year highs reflecting market concern over escalation. The IAEA's statement that it has not conducted field verification at Iranian nuclear facilities since February, combined with an upcoming Board of Governors meeting featuring Iran on the agenda, indicates ongoing nuclear diplomacy concerns amid the conflict. Iran's naval seizure of a vessel carrying 382,000 liters of smuggled fuel in the northern Gulf demonstrates continued Iranian maritime enforcement activity even during military operations.
sections.intelligence_notes: Multiple-source confirmation of US strikes on IRGC targets and Iranian retaliatory strikes against US bases in Kuwait and Bahrain indicates a confirmed cycle of direct state-on-state military action. Iranian reporting of a wedding strike in Kouhestak with 70+ casualties suggests potential for significant civilian casualty narratives that could influence international response. The shooting down of a US drone in central Iran and Iranian claims of three intercepted 'regime missiles' in Shahr-e Kord, Sirik, and Khomein require independent verification. Iran's IAEA inspection gap since February creates uncertainty about nuclear facility status, particularly the Isfahan enrichment site, which is operationally significant given the broader conflict trajectory.
